info.name: School Management System API
info.description:
API collection for the School Management System mobile apps (Student, Parent, Teacher, QR Attendance) and Super Admin web panel.

Base URL: https://floralwhite-ant-272403.hostingersite.com

Auth: Sanctum Bearer token.

Multi-School Support: This platform supports multiple schools in a single installation. All data is scoped by `school_id`. A Super Admin (school_id = null) can manage all schools; school-level admins/principals can only access their own school's data. The '7. School Management (Super Admin)' section provides CRUD endpoints for managing schools.

query.description: Returns app configuration (school_name, session_year, payment_options, etc.)

6. QR Attendance

item.name: 7. School Management (Super Admin)
item.description: School CRUD endpoints — restricted to Super Admin role. Use these to create and manage the schools running on this installation. All other data in the system is scoped per-school via `school_id`.
